channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Burg Tag
item.description: A fast-paced online multiplayer game of tag built around ridiculously satisfying movement. Wall kick, swing, slide and roll through colourful maps, and do whatever it takes to escape your friends... or tag them. No friends? Run a time trial!

item.title: Dungeon Inn
item.description: This is a cozy strategy management game where you manage an inn placed cleverly at the mouth of a dungeon. Juggle visits and business from 2 rivaling guilds, maximize profits, but keep your double-dealing a secret! Keep everyone happy and watch your inn thrive!

item.title: REAL BOUT FATAL FURY 2: THE NEWCOMERS
item.description: 1998 arcade fighter REAL BOUT FATAL FURY 2: THE NEWCOMERS is now on Steam! Featuring the largest roster in the series, 23 characters are back and ready to GET IN THE RING! Also with rollback netcode and a host of new features!

item.title: Sker Ritual
item.description: Tear through endless waves of supernatural enemies in this co-op horror horde shooter. Play solo or with up to 4 players, unleash god-like Miracle powers, supercharge your arsenal, and survive devastating boss encounters on Sker Island.

item.title: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries
item.description: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries stars the iconic, blade-wielding character from Robert Kirkman's best-selling comic books.

item.title: Victoria 3: Sphere of Influence - Expansion
item.description: Pull other nations into your orbit through diplomatic skill, economic leverage or straightforward bribery. Building a durable international faction of like-minded governments, pursuing common goals for a common good and the glory of your power.

item.title: Automobilista 2 - Lamborghini Dream Pack Pt1
item.description: First of two parts of the Lamborghini Dream Pack, featuring four models from the iconic Italian manufacturer.

item.title: Dispatch - Digital Deluxe Edition Upgrade
item.description: This content requires the base game https://store.steampowered.com/app/2592160/Dispatch/ on Steam in order to play.

item.title: Don't Starve: Reign of Giants
item.description: Don’t Starve: Reign of Giants is an expansion pack that adds new characters, seasons, creatures, biomes, and other challenges to Don’t Starve.The entire world of Don’t Starve has been expanded and is now even more uncompromising! New mysteries, challenges and scientific innovations await your discovery.

item.title: Don't Starve: Shipwrecked
item.description: Sail to adventure through the treacherous seas of Don't Starve: Shipwrecked! With new playable characters, biomes, creatures and seasonal effects; Wilson and the whole Don’t Starve cast of characters embark on a sea-bound journey of exploration, adaptation and of course, starvation.

item.title: Every Day We Fight
item.description: Turn-based tactics meets real-time choices. Control each moment of combat: react to enemy fire, aim your shots, and interrupt enemies on-the-fly. Transform a trio of ragtag civilians into seasoned soldiers - and escape the alien timeloop.

item.title: Katamari Damacy REROLL
item.description: The beloved roll-em-up game returns with fully updated graphics, completely recreated cutscenes and in full HD!

item.title: Midnight Launch: A Gameshop Sim
item.description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

item.title: Monster Prom
item.description: You have 3 weeks to get a date for Monster Prom! Go through absurd and funny situations, raise your stats and seduce one of your classmates. Beautiful art, bold, unapologetic dialogue and hard choices make up this Multiplayer (1-4 players) Dating Sim. Be your worst self.

item.title: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
item.description: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

item.title: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip
item.description: Embark on a road trip like no other in this co-op narrative survival adventure. Visit fun locations, meet wacky characters, and manage your resources wisely. And yes: you still can date some hot monsters ;)

item.title: Monster Prom: Second Term
item.description: Second Term features all-new characters, narratives and events that will provide you with countless new experiences in your quest of finding monster love.

item.title: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
item.description: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!

item.title: Popcorn & Premieren - Ausgehviertel
item.description: Expand your cinema with a leisure district featuring a pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage and event hall. Upgrade businesses, manage your investment and collect parking fees, with real financial risks as well as opportunities.

item.title: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
item.description: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

item.title: The Walking Dead: A New Frontier
item.description: After society was ripped apart by undead hands, pockets of civilization emerge from the chaos. But at what cost? Can the living be trusted on this new frontier?

item.title: The Walking Dead: Season Two
item.description: The Walking Dead: Season Two continues the story of Clementine, a young girl orphaned by the undead apocalypse. Left to fend for herself, she has been forced to learn how to survive in a world gone mad.

item.title: The Walking Dead: The Final Season
item.description: A secluded school might finally be Clementine’s chance for a home, but protecting it will mean sacrifice.

item.title: Automobilista 2 - Endurance Pack Pt3
item.description: The third part of the Endurance Pack introduces Aston Martin to AMS2, including the mighty Valkyrie Hypercar as well as the latest Vantage GT3 Evo.

item.title: Automobilista 2 - Historical Endurance Pack Pt2: 2005 Endurance
item.description: The second pack of Historical Endurance Cars, once again focused on 2005-era GT cars.

item.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced - Additional mode "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX"
item.description: "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" adds a new mode featuring Copen, protagonist of the spin-off Luminous Avenger iX 2, fighting alongside Gunvolt.

item.title: Halls of Torment
item.description: Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite. Descend into the Halls of Torment where the Lords of the underworld await you. Treasures, magical trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power to vanquish these horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?

item.title: Laid-Back Camp All -in -one!! Chill Time
item.description: Right beside you as you sit at your desk, Rin, Nadeshiko, and the others are out camping again today. You can focus on your work or studies while watching them. Create your own unique campsite using over 1,000 types of gear, and watch your focused time accumulate in your diary.

item.title: Soulmask - Bone Bash
item.description: Welcome to the fiesta of Bone Bash – yes, you're dead, but that's not the end. You and your tribesmen have simply taken on a far more entertaining form!

item.title: Groundwork Simulator
item.description: Dig, haul and wash for gold in an open-world heavy machinery simulator. Operate excavators, wheel loaders and bulldozers, reshape the terrain and build your washing setup. Work solo or team up in online co-op to turn untouched ground into a working site.

item.title: Moadra
item.description: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

item.title: Red Chat Ritual – TSUMIMI TIME
item.description: “Intervene in Tsumimi’s stream” through comments and Mega Chats, then use your deductions to change their fate in this 15-day psychological horror adventure.

item.title: Squad Weapon Skins - Recon Team Pack
item.description: This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction.
